verdict.rationale: Unity documents public scripting APIs for building against the engine (unity-docs-11) and editor extension APIs (unity-docs-10). It also distributes official libraries such as Sentis through its Package Manager (unity-docs-13, unity-docs-27), with the UPM registry resolving official packages as keyless JSON (unity-probe-rt-5). That covers the core of building against official SDKs, but the evidence is brief and machine-oriented access is uneven: there is no OpenAPI spec (unity-probe-3), and the manual has no .md mirrors or llms.txt (unity-probe-2, unity-probe-rt-2). Missing for 10: in-depth evidence of the SDK reference and language coverage, official service/REST SDKs or an OpenAPI spec, machine-readable manual docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
